# PR Channel

> PR Channel (operated by Jingmen Anmao Network Technology Co., Ltd., Jingmen, Hubei, China) provides press release distribution in China for overseas companies: media matching, editorial submission, placement verification and China-based media communications support. Operating since 2021.

Core service: Press Release Distribution in China. Related services: media invitation in China, and media placement verification before payment.
